div.head: Episc 2
div.ab: Inprimis debet omnem ordinatum instruere, quid ei iure pertineat facere (sit agendum), et quid hominibus secularibus indicare debeant.
He sceall gehadode men ærest gewissian, þæt heora ælc wite, hwæt him mid rihte gebyrige to donne, ⁊ eac hwæt hy woruldmannum agan to beodanne.
He sceall gehadode men ærest gewissian, þæt heora ælc wite hwæt him mid rihte gebyrige to donne and eac hwæt hy woruldmannum agan to beodanne.
First, he must oversee men in orders so that each of them may know what is properly fitting for him to do and also what they should preach to the laity.
Erstens soll er geweihte Männer (Kleriker) anleiten, dass ihrer jeder wisse, was ihm [dem Kleriker] von Rechts wegen zu thun gebühre, und auch was sie Laien verkünden [gebieten] sollen.
First, he shall instruct ordained men (clerics), so that each of them knows what it rightly befits him [the cleric] to do, and also what they ought to proclaim [enjoin] to laymen.
